state:
- The CDK5–Nup98 claim leaves the modified residue undefined, and a ≥50% occupancy drop after CDK5 deletion can come from indirect stress or phosphatase shifts. Pre-register one Nup98 S/T site as an explicit assumption, require a direct CDK5 kinase assay on that peptide, and include a proline-directed kinase panel so assignment is kinase-specific.
- Initiation, necessity, and falsification all gate on the NLS nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, which a sequestration model can move by the same percentages. Make the primary endpoint the size-step passive leak (about 20 kDa versus about 70 kDa) that persists after G3BP1-granule and G3BP1-negative TDP-43-assembly blockade and that incorporated S/T-to-A Nup98 prevents.
- Necessity is rejected only when S/T-to-A replacement fails and a blockade arm restores import, so the double-failure case stays unclassified, and the ≥70% NPC-incorporation rule never states knock-in versus overexpression. Reject necessity whenever incorporated non-phosphorylatable Nup98 fails to prevent the leak and import phenotype, specify endogenous replacement, and add a doxycycline-inducible NLS-intact TDP-43 arm so overexpression stress is separated from ΔNLS-triggered initiation.
